build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter api build

deploy.preDeployCommand: n=0; until pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate deploy; do n=$((n+1)); if [ $n -ge 6 ]; then echo 'Migration failed after 6 attempts - giving up.'; exit 1; fi; echo "DB not ready yet (attempt $n/6), retrying in 5s..."; sleep 5; done
